title: FernData
summary: A Django 5 + Postgres customer-billing portal: an IDOR on both a numeric account route and an /api/profile query param leaks every customer's billing PII, a bio field rendered with |safe is stored XSS, and a legacy-import auth row carries an unsalted MD5 hash that cracks offline alongside the normal pbkdf2 users.

loot.description: customer billing PII (name, billing email, phone, card last-4, MRR), reachable via the IDOR and directly in Postgres

cmd: SELECT password FROM auth_user WHERE username='svc_import'
loot.description: a legacy-import auth row stored as an unsalted MD5 (md5$$ format) that cracks to sunshine, alongside normal pbkdf2 users
a stored <script> payload in a customer bio rendered through |safe on the public account page
